structured.approach: I followed the DE-05 procedure in the data-engineering-steps skill, which reads task.components and org.data_model and writes feat.data_model_change. I read both contracted inputs, the ap_pipeline tool view and the shared memory and journey board. Through context_list and context_get I read the approved feat.design (DES-02) as background, with a receipt, to ground the DC-1/DC-2 contracts and the B1.2 to B1.5 rules. I ran the allowed CI command and git status on the unchanged checkout to confirm the baseline. Both passed, and the working tree was clean. A stale draft from another run was already at the output path: it said attempt 2, used other input revisions and old item IDs (TC-1/TC-2). I replaced it in full with an attempt-1 document built on the current inputs (IN-1 to IN-9). The step changes the data model only. Code changes (IN-3, IN-7) belong to DE-08, so I left src/ap_pipeline/ untouched. No connector was needed.

claims.text: The registered Invoice entity already includes paid_date (date or None), added in feed v3, so no Invoice field is added, removed or retyped.
transform.to_model today produces only id, vendor, due_date, amount and paid. It does not produce paid_date, and it rejects rows with reason type(e).__name__.
IN-3 adds PAID_DATE_REASON = "paid_date" and _parse_paid_date. paid_date is parsed only after the existing try block succeeds, so the existing reject reason wins.
The Rejected row gains the new reason value paid_date. dq.quality_report needs no change because reject_reasons is the sorted set of reasons.

The Delay history (DC-2) is a new derived in-memory structure Dict[str, List[int]], produced by delays.delays_by_vendor. delay_days = (paid_date - due_date).days, and it covers only paid records with a paid_date, in feed order, with negative values kept.
Feed v2 without a paid_date column still loads, with paid_date = None on every record. Existing keys, the to_model signature and the (records, rejected) shape are unchanged.
No storage, database or schema migration is involved, and pipeline.run and schedule.json stay unchanged.
Invalid paid_date test values are "2026-13-01" and "not-a-date" only.

open_questions: DMQ-1: Should org.data_model be extended org-wide with the Rejected-row reason value 'paid_date' and the Delay history structure? Today it describes only Invoice. Interim: this document is the feature-level change. Owner: data engineering lead / data modelers.
DMQ-2 (carried CQ-I1): Is the feed v3 header spelled exactly 'paid_date'? Interim: yes.
DMQ-3 (carried OQ-B6/DD-7): Should an unpaid record keep a valid paid_date? Interim: yes; the Delay history ignores it.
DMQ-4 (carried DQ-4): Should delays_by_vendor be re-exported from __init__.py? Interim: no.
DMQ-5 (carried TQ-10/DD-6): Does an existing reject reason win over paid_date? Interim: yes.
structured.summary: I wrote feat.data_model_change for DE-05, attempt 1. The registered Invoice entity already has paid_date (date or None), so no Invoice field is added, removed or retyped. The model change has three parts. First, the feed v3 contract gains an optional paid_date column. Second, the Rejected row gains the reason value 'paid_date'. Third, a new in-memory Delay history structure, Dict[str, List[int]], is produced by delays_by_vendor and consumed by ap_forecast. The document also covers compatibility (feed v2 still loads), knowledge-graph relations and schema-validation rules for DE-09. There is no storage or migration and no code change in this step; IN-3 and IN-7 are implemented in DE-08. CI passes on the unchanged checkout. There are five non-blocking open questions and no blocking ones.
